title: Weather Scientist
shareTitle: Weather Scientist 🌦️ — Make a Living World Change
description: Choose a meadow, desert, arctic, or rainforest, then bring sunlight, rain, wind, and clouds into that living watercolor world. Four gentle guided discoveries teach cause and effect, then an open observatory lets children combine weather and reveal a rainbow. For ages 5–6.
learningGoals: Connect sunlight, rain, wind, and cloud cover to visible changes in a living place
Practice cause-and-effect reasoning by making and combining weather states
Compare how the same weather behaves differently across meadow, desert, arctic, and rainforest climates
Build weather vocabulary through immediate visual and spoken feedback
Develop controlled horizontal movement with a real wind-strength slider
interactionModel: Tap three large watercolor weather cards and drag one wind-strength dial to transform the same persistent meadow; finish the guided discoveries, then combine states freely.
feedbackModel: Every input changes the world immediately through authored weather layers, raster rain and leaves, plant growth, low ambient sound, a progress badge, and warm local narration. Non-target input gets a brief truthful preview and gentle redirect, never an error.

modes.title: Weather Lab
modes.skill: cause and effect in a changing weather system
